g.text: R2 | 3.3 V default, 5 V only after bench validation | 32 ohm load | 50 x 35 mm PCB

g.desc: R2 | 3.3 V default, 5 V only after bench validation | 32 ohm load | 50 x 35 mm PCB

g.text: C1/C2: + to VREF/VDD. C3: leaded ceramic, short leads by U1 pin 8.

g.desc: C1/C2: + to VREF/VDD. C3: leaded ceramic, short leads by U1 pin 8.

g.text: U1 pin1 = OUTA. Bottom placement is mirrored in top view.

g.desc: U1 pin1 = OUTA. Bottom placement is mirrored in top view.

g.text: JP1/JP2 = LEFT; JP3/JP4 = RIGHT. All are open copper pads before assembly.

g.desc: JP1/JP2 = LEFT; JP3/JP4 = RIGHT. All are open copper pads before assembly.

g.text: ATTENUATED default: solder 1-2 on all four jumpers. DIRECT: clear 1-2, then solder 2-3.

g.desc: ATTENUATED default: solder 1-2 on all four jumpers. DIRECT: clear 1-2, then solder 2-3.

g.text: Change BOTH selectors of a channel together. This isolates the unused divider at both ends.

g.text: Loaded ATT midband = -16.4 dB before 2.2R output. Active stage = -1. Input capacitors nonpolar.

g.text: C6/C7 positive terminals toward U1. No headphones on RAW outputs. Cable stability requires bench test.
